setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Slot 1 holds the whole project, including the pickup on step 15 at velocity 35. Global length is the default 64, Repeats is 1 and Song mode is On; slots 2 and 3 are empty. Playback is stopped.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), hold slot 1 at (1,1), tap slot 2 at (2,1), release slot 1 and tap (2,1) again to select slot 2. Holding slot 1 while you tap slot 2 copies the whole section (patterns, channel settings, masks and mutes). The screen reads SLOT SETUP, SONG 02, the tooltip says Song sequence 2 selected, and (2,1) is the bright slot button. The next two steps check the copy: slot 2 stays audible when slot 1 is muted.
steps.title: Copy the complete section

steps.caption: Select slot 1 at (1,1), tap Channel (3,8), then hold K1, tap (1,1) and release K1. K1 is the shift key from chapter 1: K1 plus a channel button mutes that channel in this slot only. The title reads CH01 MUTE and the tooltip says Channel 1 muted: slot 1 will play the bass alone.
steps.title: Mute channel 1 in slot 1

steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), select slot 2 at (2,1) and tap Channel (3,8). The title reads CH01 S02 with no MUTE: channel 1 is audible in slot 2, so slot 2 keeps the full phrase.
steps.title: Check slot 2 stays full

steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), select slot 1 at (1,1), tap (3,7) on the length fader, then tap (8,7) three times. The fader is row 7, columns 1 to 8: (3,7) jumps to 13 steps and each tap of (8,7) adds one, so 13 + 3 = 16. SONG PLAYBACK, SONG 01 shows Global length 16; Song mode reads AUTO there, which means Song mode is on and advancing.
steps.title: Set slot 1 to one bar

steps.caption: Optional check. Open Slot setup from Song tasks (E1 right one detent, E2 to Slot setup, K3), select Repeats, turn E3 left until it reads 1 and press K3. Repeats already starts at 1: SLOT SETUP, SONG 01 shows Repeats 1.
steps.title: Optional: check Repeats for slot 1

steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), select slot 2 at (2,1), tap (3,7), then tap (8,7) three times: 13 + 3 = 16 again. SONG PLAYBACK, SONG 02 shows Global length 16.
steps.title: Set slot 2 to one bar

steps.caption: Optional check. Open Slot setup, select Repeats, turn E3 left until it reads 1 and press K3. SLOT SETUP, SONG 02 shows Repeats 1, the default.
steps.title: Optional: check Repeats for slot 2

steps.caption: Check SLOT SETUP, SONG 02 shows Song mode On before pressing K3.
steps.title: Read Song mode before confirming

steps.caption: Optional check. In Slot setup select Song mode, turn E3 right to On and press K3. SLOT SETUP, SONG 02 shows Song mode On, the default: the song moves from slot 1 to slot 2 and wraps to slot 1 because slot 3 is empty.
steps.title: Optional: check Song mode

steps.caption: Select slot 1, tap Play (1,8) and listen to slot 1 first. SLOT SETUP, SONG 01 stays on screen with Song mode On, the slot button (1,1) is bright, and the MIDI strip shows only the bass (port 2: note 48, then 55, velocity 100) because channel 1 is muted in this slot.
steps.title: Hear slot 1

steps.caption: Keep listening for the second section (about 2.7 s later) and then tap Play to stop; four 16-step sections run in all (about 10.7 s). The screen follows the song to SLOT SETUP, SONG 02 and the bright slot button moves to (2,1). The MIDI strip now shows the phrase on port 1 (60, 60, 60 at velocity 80, 62 at 50 and the pickup 60 at 35) joining the bass, only in the sections that play slot 2.
steps.title: Hear slot 2 join
